Explicit reconstruction, not author runtime equivalence
activeFOS: All canonical hierarchy masks with size < rint((N/12.0)*10.0), matching active source threshold and ties-to-even rounding; current qualified N>=20. No root or large-mask hidden addition
donors: Snapshot all100 parents at generation start, including possible self-donor. One uniform parent donor per mask, retained for its two phases; offspring cannot become current-generation donors. Commit all100 program exits synchronously
program: For each working receiver, shuffle activeFOS using common seeded RNG; per mask, phase1 differential-position/OX with uniform selected reference, then phase2 selected relative order. Both phases copy the selected jobs' complete FMW; leave other tuples attached to owners. The second phase uses the first phase result only if accepted
jointExtension: Both mask phases copy full FMW, including singleton order masks which may change resources. This extends permutation-only native behavior; it is not a bug fix or claimed original qGOMEA
nativeSkipAdaptation: Do not import native pre/post no-op evaluation skips into this strict attempt contract. Each generated phase attempt, including duplicate, equal, rootless singleton identity and missing-factory fallback, is evaluated/charged once. No free repair, resampling or latent full evaluations
failureHandling: Missing-factory candidate falls back to unchanged actual working parent, remains a paid phase attempt. All other illegal representations fail engineering with retained receipts/logs
FI: Disabled in this selected available author PFS preset; no extra elitist copy, stagnation trigger or multi-pbest. A later FI experiment would require its own protocol

output: Common exact unbounded all-successful-evaluation result archive, including rejected/duplicate paid attempts; internal working archive separately observed. No free public-pool import
